questions.question: Did the executive introduce themselves?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive clearly communicates their name and professional identity.

questions.question: Did the executive identify their organization?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive mentions the company or organization they represent.

questions.question: Did the executive understand the customer's requirements?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive asks relevant questions and understands the customer's needs.

questions.question: Did the executive ask about the customer's budget?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive asks about or confirms the customer's budget.

questions.question: Did the executive understand the customer's preferred location?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive asks about or confirms the preferred location.

questions.question: Did the executive explain relevant product details?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive explains product features relevant to the customer's requirements.

questions.question: Did the executive explain the next steps?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive communicates what will happen after the call.

questions.question: Did the executive communicate professionally?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive uses respectful and professional language throughout the call.

questions.question: Did the executive close the conversation professionally?
questions.expected_behavior: Executive ends the call politely and appropriately.
